title: Library timings and facilities
content: Bennett University's Learning Resource Centre lists the Central Library and Law Library as open 24/7, with the LRC and holidays also listed as 24/7. Circulation service for book issue or renewal is listed as 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, while book returns are available 24/7 through the RFID book drop box. The library lists print collection, e-books, e-journals, databases, remote access, research support, Turnitin, borrowing, reference service, membership and inter-library loan services.
